messages:
Priya (VP Infra): quick follow-up from the infra section 1: clarifying regional GPU buffering, autoscale, and a few action items. drop quick q we'll answer fast.

Maya (PM): is the plan to keep warm pools on 24/7 or only sustain minimal base during business hours? asking from cost/SLAs POV.

Priya (VP Infra): base plan v1: small always-on reserve (2 nodes/zone) for APAC/EMEA critical zones, plus elastic burst. we29re testing a time-of-day policy for non-critical regions to save cost.

Rosa (SRE): what29s the autoscaler cooldown again? we had some noise during yesterday29s deploy.

Arjun (Capacity): cooldown v0 = 180s. we29re experimenting with hold windows for rapid oscillations (extend to 300s if queue depth oscillates).

Tom (Platform): priming jobs look like traffic spikes 6 autoscaler sometimes scales up. can we mark priming as internal to avoid scale actions?

Arjun (Capacity): yes, will tag priming with traffic.metadata=priming and add an ignore-policy up to 5% of cluster capacity.

Rosa (SRE): finance asked for a simple number: monthly incremental cost for keeping a 2-node warm pool per APAC zone vs pure on-demand. any quick thumb?

Priya (VP Infra): rough thumb: ~+$7k/month per zone at current cloud list prices (nodes + minimal infra). Tom will provide exact spreadsheet.

Maya (PM): H100 timeline? any change from the all-hands note?

Arjun (Capacity): still target next quarter for partner capacity; Dedicated opt-in ~4 weeks post-arrival after safety checks.

Tom (Platform): small docs ask: which models are excluded from warm pools? can we publish a short rule-of-thumb?

Priya (VP Infra): rule-of-thumb: models that require non-standard kernels or >16GB scratch on startup are excluded until validated. full list in model-catalog when ready.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: job "priming-job/apac-buffer-priming" started (jb-2026-09-02-1015).

Rosa (SRE): action: please add dashboard annotation for priming windows so we can correlate.

Arjun (Capacity): noted 6 will add annotation and the priming tag.

Priya (VP Infra): ACTIONS: 1) Tom to share exact finance spreadsheet by Fri. 2) Arjun to tag priming + autoscaler ignore rule. 3) Priya to publish model-eligibility blurb. will stitch into all-hands notes.

Maya (PM): thanks 1 that29s helpful.

Priya (VP Infra): thanks everyone 1 closing thread after actions posted.
